capabilities: Import Word tracked changes and comments as review batches
Match suggestions to passages in scene notes
Accept, reject, rewrite, defer or archive each change
Pin Editorialism directives to anchored passages
Schedule revision work against deadlines and daily capacity
disambiguation: Not an AI editor or writing assistant; it never calls an AI itself and only imports feedback produced elsewhere.
extras: Makes no network calls and holds no API keys; feedback must be formatted by an AI outside the plugin, and smaller local models may not follow the format. Ships no default hotkeys. A separate user manual covers Word files, responding to editors, editor engagement and the author planner.
problem: Editorial feedback arrives as Word files or AI-written notes, and applying it scene by scene while tracking decisions, replies and deadlines is manual work.

relations.evidence: follow Radial Timeline, which lists your books and switches both plugins to the one you choose

summary: Revision workflow that imports an editor's Word tracked changes or AI-formatted review batches into scene notes and lets you decide each change.
